explanation: Axel Paulsen, Alois Lutz and Ulrich Salchow lent their names to the jumps. The Axel is the only one of the three that takes off facing forwards.

claims.text: The Axel, the Lutz and the Salchow are figure skating jumps named after the skaters who first performed them.
Gymnastics, diving and ski jumping have no moves called the Axel, the Lutz and the Salchow.
The Axel is named after Axel Paulsen, the Lutz after Alois Lutz and the Salchow after Ulrich Salchow.
Of the Axel, the Lutz and the Salchow, only the Axel takes off facing forwards.
